raw_response:
The issuer demonstrates strong liquidity with a current ratio of 2.04 and moderate leverage with a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.70, supporting investment grade. However, low profitability—4% operating margin and approximately 2.2% net margin—along with a quarterly ROE of about 0.58% (annualized roughly 2.32%), indicates weak earnings capacity, capping the rating at the lower end of investment grade. Retained earnings of 39,480M provide some historical strength but do not fully offset current profitability concerns.

DECISION: BBB
